text: 10 minutes daily without a phone: sit on the floor, let him lead the play. He points to something? Say its name. He makes a sound? Imitate it. He smiles? Smile back at him. Presence builds secure attachment.

review_defects.why: English adds a transliteration not present in the Arabic.
The English adds a transliterated Arabic gloss '(al-ta'alluq al-amin)' that is not an established Islamic term in the allowed list and is not present as a standalone term in the Arabic.
